covers: JSE morning session Friday 6 November 2026 (prices to about 10:45 SAST); US figures are Thursday 5 November closes
headline: Sappi (LRC Stock Scanner: SELL) −7.8% on results day; JSE rally cools as Naspers, Prosus and Shoprite slip while gold miners and TFG (+9.7%) rise
summary: By mid-morning the JSE All Share stood at 112,845 and the Top 40 at 104,783, up 4.9% and 5.4% on a week ago, but Thursday's leaders gave some back: Naspers −1.7%, Prosus −2.6% and Shoprite −4.4% (LRC prices, 6 Nov 10:43 SAST). In the US the S&P 500 closed Thursday at 7,353.73 and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,315.00, down 3.0% and 4.4% on the week, with the 10-year Treasury yield at 4.84% (LRC Market Dashboard, 5 Nov close). The rand was at R16.50/$, gold at $4,082.80, platinum at $1,537 and Brent at $97.48, down 17.1% on a week ago; press reports on today's results and the election count could not be opened this run, so only LRC's own price data is used.

items.title: Sappi −7.8% to R12.02 on results day (LRC Stock Scanner: SELL, target R11.22)
items.summary: Sappi was due to release its Q4 and full-year results to 30 September 2026 at 08:00 SAST today, with a call at 15:00 SAST (Sappi investor calendar, compiled by LRC Research 31 Oct). The share traded at R12.02 at 10:42, down 7.75% from Thursday's R13.03 close, and is now about 7% above the scanner's blended target of R11.22. The rating is unchanged by this desk; results figures will be added once the announcement is verified.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance prices), 6 Nov 2026 10:42–10:43 SAST; LRC JSE results calendar (31 Oct 2026)

items.title: S&P 500 7,353.73, Nasdaq 24,315.00 at Thursday's close
items.summary: The S&P 500 is down 3.0% and the Nasdaq Composite 4.4% against a week ago (30 Oct closes). The US 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.84%, from 4.93% a week earlier. The US October jobs report is due today at 15:30 SAST.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance closes), 5 Nov 2026

items.title: JSE: Thursday's leaders give back gains
items.summary: Mid-morning moves against Thursday's close: Shoprite −4.4% to R327.58, Glencore −3.4%, British American Tobacco −2.9%, Prosus −2.6% to R690.61, Anglo American −2.3%, Richemont −2.1%, Naspers −1.7% to R764.04. Banks were close to flat: FirstRand −0.1%, Standard Bank −0.7%, Absa +0.1%. The All Share (112,845) and Top 40 (104,783) remain 4.9% and 5.4% above their 30 Oct levels.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance prices), 6 Nov 2026 10:42–10:43 SAST; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance prices), 6 Nov 2026 10:58 SAST
